code: Parse glTF JSON and populate model.images[].uri from attacker input
note: The malicious URI is attacker-controlled input embedded in the glTF document.
A glTF image/buffer URI flows into external-file resolution, reaching the path-expansion routine.
The resolved candidate path is passed to the filesystem callback for expansion.
The attacker-controlled URI is only quoted, not sanitized, before shell-style expansion.
wordexp interprets the quoted string using shell expansion rules, so metacharacters can trigger unintended expansion and reach the vulnerable sink.
